messages:
maria: FYI eu-west dedicated dashboard shows 0 GPUs for cluster rc-77 after nodegroup swap. Apps and pods look fine, no scaling errors. :eyes:
ryan: looking. Do the nodes show up in k8s? run: `kubectl get nodes -l nodepool=dedicated-rc-77 -o wide`
maria: nodes present, 12 Ready. Each node reports `nvidia.com/gpu: 8` locally. Problem appears only in the console panel (Dedicated -> Capacity -> Node GPUs).
ops-bot: deploy finished: nodegroup rc-77 AMI swap completed at 2026-03-05T10:12Z (rolling update).
sophia: which panel/query is returning 0? can you paste it?
maria: panel query in console: `sum by (cluster) (node_gpu_total)` for cluster rc-77 returns 0. Prometheus graph in infra shows recent points missing for that cluster.
ryan: suspect telemetry label mismatch after the AMI/launch-template change. Check telemetry pods: `kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep telemetry`
maria: telemetry-daemonset rc-telemetry-abc shows CrashLoopBackOff on one node. logs: `E0305 10:11:05 main.go:72] failed to read /sys/class/vgpu: permission denied`
james: if the telemetry DS failed during the roll the ingestion pipeline might have marked the cluster as offline. Try forcing a restart: `kubectl delete pod rc-telemetry-abc-xxxxx -n kube-system` to force reschedule.
maria: restarted the daemonset pod, new pod Running. Prometheus targets now show node exporters healthy, but console still 0 GPUs for rc-77. :thinking:
support-bot: Observability pipeline note: last successful ingest for cluster rc-77 was 2026-03-05T10:11:00Z. Backfill job queued (attempt 1).
sophia: another angle: console indexes nodes by specific labels/annotations. During the AMI swap we accidentally removed the `redwood/dedicated` node label in the launch template. Console filters nodes by `redwood/dedicated=true` + annotation `cluster-variant=dedicated`.
ryan: that would explain it — metrics exist but the console filter ignores unlabeled nodes. Quick test: label a node and see. `kubectl label node ip-10-0-1-23 redwood/dedicated=true`
maria: relabeled a single node as test, the dashboard immediately shows 8 GPUs for rc-77. Confirmed. Relabeling remaining nodes now via script.
james: adding a post-swap hook to the ASG/launch template and a prewarm job to ensure labels persist. I'll open a GH issue for the fix. (#9876)
maria: relabel script finished, dashboard back to normal for rc-77. 
ryan: follow-up action: add an alert that fires when `sum(node_gpu_total) == 0 && kube_node_info with gpu capacity > 0` to catch labeling vs ingestion mismatches.
ops-bot: escalation ticket created ESC-2026-331 for the customer-facing impact and follow-ups.
maria: filing customer update: root cause = labels dropped during AMI swap; mitigation = relabel + daemonset restart; fix = launch-template hook + alert. Marking P1 -> resolved, will monitor. :thumbsup:
